title: Forms Technology And Generate Mode
description: Introduce forms technology (declarative form data, question kinds, multi-step builder playground) and flow Generate mode where input widgets become forms and generations are saved submissions evaluated through the worker pipeline. Extend ui with Catalogue, cross-container tree reorder, and Field primitives.
summary: Fixed hexagonal column preview and semantic parameter labels. Rewrote hexagonal-mushroom-column.procedural.json with semantic sliders (height, radius, sides), explicit labels/units, extrude output wired to outputPreview node, and removed the brep/list-get face chain. flowFixtureToFormSpec reads widget label/name and infers labels from synapse ports for legacy slider_N ids. Forms Flow3dQuestionControl uses preferGeometryPreviewItems so BRep solids render instead of extrusion vectors. Updated building-component.forms.json params and tests. forms-core and forms-react tests pass.
